name: A running turn keeps its spend on disk
prose: the session ledger (usage per model, API time, context) is written to the transcript while a turn runs — after model calls, at most every 30 s — not only when the turn ends, so a crash in the middle of an hour-long turn still leaves that hour's accounting for `/resume` and `/session`.
invariant: The spend of the model calls a turn has already made is on disk while the turn is still running.
